cases.explain: «Тибериадского моря» — after the preposition «у», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: After these things, Jesus revealed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias. He revealed himself this way.

cases.sentence: ___ поплыли за ним на лодке, подтягивая сеть, полную рыбы.
cases.explain: «Другие ученики» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: But the other disciples came in the little boat (for they were not far from the land, but about two hundred cubits away), dragging the net full of fish.

cases.sentence: Это уже в ___ Иисус пришел к Своим ученикам после того, как Он воскрес из мертвых.
cases.explain: «третий раз» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: This is now the third time that Jesus was revealed to his disciples after he had risen from the dead.

cases.explain: «второй раз» — after the preposition «во», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: He said to him again a second time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Tend my sheep.”

cases.explain: «третий раз» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: He said to him the third time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me?” Peter was grieved because he asked him the third time, “Do you have affection for me?” He said to him, “Lord, you know everything. You know that I have affection for you.” Jesus said to him, “Feed my sheep.
